response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices FROM order_counts), shares AS (SELECT oc.order_id, oc.invoice_count, CAST(oc.invoice_count AS REAL) / t.total_invoices AS share FROM order_counts oc CROSS JOIN totals t), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.invoice_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS excess FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(excess) AS average_excess FROM above;
